title: SvgAnimateMotion
responsibility: Renders the native animateMotion element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgAnimateMotion.attributes
inputs.description: Native animateMotion attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgAnimateMotion.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native animateMotion element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgAnimateMotion
outputs.description: The actual native animateMotion element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
